checks.name: synthetic cloud fixture requires a private control secret
uninitialized cloud ledger refuses deletion and preserves current access
cloud cutover initializes coverage once without replacing the bucket
eight concurrent first cloud writes preserve exactly one event and first timestamp
completed cloud deletion leaves only ID/time in separate ledger after its D1 job is removed
actual D1 Time Travel resurrects invented deleted profile while separate R2 ledger survives unchanged
cloud manifest rejects a backup older than cutover or a replaced ledger identity
cloud recovery reads deletion events from original ledger instead of a hand-written manifest
ledger-guided cloud sanitation removes old profile/access and preserves other profile/history without reopening service
cloud bounded expiry removes aged events while retaining cutover metadata

source: isolated actual Cloudflare D1 Time Travel and separate private R2 buckets; fresh Worker/DO namespaces
expiry: fixture clock +36 days; provider automatic lifecycle not measured
clockNote: Initial PC clock was approximately two seconds behind provider; a coverage interval before ledger cutover was rejected. Successful run used provider clocks.
conditionalWriteNote: Initial wrapper reported concurrent-write rejections without provider details. Completed-winner read or closed failure/retry added; later checks passed.
finalLocalHardening: Start-bound event timestamp validation additionally checked locally after cloud run.
